sourceIdentity: The source is the unique original primitive standard representative of h0*t modulo31, with h0=25*h31 mod31. Original integer coefficients are computed modulo961 and agree with every frozen primitive model coefficient modulo31. Every coefficient of A*x0-h0*t is checked divisible by31. The output is exactly (h0*t-A*x0)/31 mod31. No correction, mod961 target identity, or characteristic-zero membership is asserted.
